# adnivedAnalytics

## What is this?
adnivedAnalytics is a privacy-first web analytics platform. It provides website owners with visitor insights, traffic sources, pageview tracking, conversion goals, and funnel analysis — all without using cookies, fingerprinting, or collecting personal data. It is fully GDPR and CCPA compliant by design.

## Who is it for?
Website owners, marketers, and developers who want accurate analytics without compromising visitor privacy. It is an alternative to Google Analytics that respects user privacy.

## Key Features
- **No cookies, no tracking scripts that invade privacy** — lightweight (<1 KB) tracking script
- **Real-time dashboard** — see current visitors and live traffic
- **Traffic sources & UTM tracking** — know where your visitors come from
- **Pages & content analytics** — see which pages get the most traffic
- **Geographic & technology breakdowns** — visitor locations, browsers, devices, OS
- **Goals & conversion tracking** — define goals and measure conversions
- **Funnels** — build multi-step funnels to track user journeys
- **Campaigns** — track UTM-tagged marketing campaigns
- **Public shared dashboards** — share analytics publicly with a link
- **Team collaboration** — invite team members with viewer or admin roles
- **CSV export** — export your data anytime

## Pages

### Public Pages
- **Homepage** (https://adnived.com/): Overview of the product, features, pricing, testimonials, and FAQ
- **Features** (https://adnived.com/features): Detailed overview of all analytics features — privacy by design, real-time insights, goals, funnels, UTM tracking, geographic data, and more
- **Pricing** (https://adnived.com/pricing): Simple, transparent pricing plans — Free, Pro ($5/mo), and Max ($10/mo) with FAQ
- **Privacy-First Analytics** (https://adnived.com/privacy-first): How adnivedAnalytics is built for a privacy-first world — no cookies, no personal data, with links to GDPR, CCPA, and PECR compliance pages
- **Documentation** (https://adnived.com/docs): Guides on getting started, adding the tracking script, tracking goals, UTM parameters, API usage, and more
- **UTM Builder** (https://adnived.com/utm-builder): Free tool to generate UTM-tagged URLs for marketing campaign tracking
- **Refer & Earn** (https://adnived.com/refer): Referral program — invite friends and earn free months
- **Privacy Policy** (https://adnived.com/privacy): How data is handled — no personal data collected, no cookies used
- **Terms of Service** (https://adnived.com/terms): Usage terms for the platform
- **GDPR Compliant Analytics** (https://adnived.com/gdpr-compliant-analytics): How adnivedAnalytics helps websites comply with GDPR without cookie banners
- **CCPA Compliant Analytics** (https://adnived.com/ccpa-compliant-analytics): How adnivedAnalytics simplifies CCPA compliance by collecting no personal data
- **PECR Compliant Analytics** (https://adnived.com/pecr-compliant-analytics): How adnivedAnalytics avoids PECR cookie consent requirements entirely
- **Sign Up** (https://adnived.com/signup): Create a free account
- **Log In** (https://adnived.com/login): Access your dashboard

### Authenticated Pages
- **Dashboard** (https://adnived.com/dashboard): Manage your tracked websites, view your plan, and account settings
- **Site Analytics** (https://adnived.com/sites/:id): Detailed analytics for a specific website including overview, sources, campaigns, pages, locations, technology, goals, funnels, and settings
- **Shared Dashboard** (https://adnived.com/share/:id): Public read-only analytics view (if enabled by site owner)

## Pricing
- **Free**: 1,000 pageviews/month, 1 site
- **Pro** ($5/mo): 100,000 pageviews/month, 10 sites
- **Max** ($10/mo): 10,000,000 pageviews/month, 100 sites
